title: Design system agent manifest
description: Everything a coding agent needs to use the design system: every public export with its kind, props, variants, stories, tokens and usage rules; the tokens; the guides and examples; the agent rules and the repo commands. Generated by scripts/manifest.ts into design-system.manifest.json; npm run manifest:check and tests/unit/manifest.test.ts fail when the committed file is stale or stops matching this schema. Uses only type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items and enum: the subset that schemaProblems in scripts/checks/token-usage.ts checks.

$comment.description: Provenance: what generated the file and how to regenerate it.

entry.description: The public entry point. Consumer code imports from here only.

rules.description: The agent rules block, verbatim from CLAUDE.md between the agent-rules markers.

commands.description: Repo commands, from README.md's Scripts table.

items.description: A Guides or Foundations page of the gallery.

summary.description: The lead paragraph under the h1.

path.description: Repo-relative story file that renders the page.

items.description: A Guides or Foundations page of the gallery.

summary.description: The lead paragraph under the h1.

path.description: Repo-relative story file that renders the page.

examples.description: Golden examples, one per page archetype. Copy structure from these, not from other screens.

summary.description: First paragraph of the file's header comment.

path.description: Repo-relative source of the golden example.

exports.description: Every public export of src/index.ts, sorted by name.

kind.description: type-only: exported as a type. component, primitive, layout: a function component in src/components, src/primitives or src/layouts. utility: any other value (hooks, providers outside the UI layers, the vars map).

status.description: A @status JSDoc tag, or "deprecated" for @deprecated; null otherwise.

description.description: JSDoc on the export; for a unit without one, the first "when to use" line of its usage doc.

partOf.description: The unit folder this export belongs to, when it is not the unit itself (TableRow → Table, ButtonVariant → Button).

propsOf.description: For a props type: the component it types. The props are listed on that component.

docs.description: Repo-relative usage doc that covers this export.

signature.description: Hooks and other functions: the call signature.

definition.description: Type-only exports: the declaration, comments removed, on one line.

values.description: Type-only exports that are unions of literals: the values.

props.description: Function components: their props, in declaration order. Escape hatches are reported in closedApi, not here.

items.description: One prop. Props inherited from React's DOM attribute interfaces are not listed one by one: see inherits.

type.description: The type as TypeScript text: the declared annotation for the system's own props, the checker's text for third-party ones.

required.description: False when the prop is optional.

default.description: Default value from the component's parameter destructuring, as source text; null when there is none.

values.description: The closed set of values, when the type is a union of literals, in the order it is written.

deprecated.description: The @deprecated note, when there is one.

inherits.description: React DOM, ARIA and event attribute interfaces the props extend (HTMLAttributes, ButtonHTMLAttributes…).

closedApi.description: The closed styling API, as the props type states it.

className.description: Props accept className. Always false: the styling API is closed.

UNSAFE_className.description: The UNSAFE_className escape hatch is present (consumer use needs a reasoned lint disable).

UNSAFE_style.description: The UNSAFE_style escape hatch is present.

variants.description: Props whose type is a closed union of 2 to 12 literals (variant, size, tone, gap…), with their values. Longer vocabularies (icon names) are in props[].values only.

usage.description: The usage doc (docs/usage/<Name>.usage.tsx), on the export the doc is named after. Its parts carry only docs.

whenToUse.description: When to reach for it. Strings mark code with backticks.

whenNotToUse.description: When not to, and what to use instead.

do.description: A live example from the usage doc.

caption.description: What the example shows and why it is right (or wrong).

code.description: The source of its render function (TSX).

dont.description: A live example from the usage doc.

caption.description: What the example shows and why it is right (or wrong).

code.description: The source of its render function (TSX).

accessibility.description: What the component guarantees, and what the caller still owns.

stories.description: Stories of an export that has its own usage doc but is not a UI unit (LocaleProvider): titles ending in /<Name>.

id.description: Storybook story id, from Storybook's own CSF parser.

unit.description: Unit-level facts, on the export a component, primitive or layout folder is named after.

stories.description: Every story whose title ends in /<Name>: one per variant, size and state.

id.description: Storybook story id, from Storybook's own CSF parser.

composes.description: Every unit reached through composition, transitively (token-usage.json composesAll).

tokens.description: Every token the unit reads, itself or through what it composes. Each one's value and alias chain are in the top-level tokens.
Every semantic and component token (and any other a unit reads), keyed by dotted path.

tier.description: Token tier. Primitives appear only when a unit reads one.

description.description: The token's $description, or its nearest group's: what it is for.

value.description: The base (light) value as CSS text, aliases resolved.

chain.description: The alias chain from this token to the raw value.

modes.description: Values in other modes (dark, reduced-motion), only where the token or its chain defines one.
